description:
## Why
The operator and Overwatch need one readable cross-workspace list explaining which tab needs attention, with a reliable jump to that tab. Backlog item: A2.

## Evidence
- c11 on origin/main (`0ff8887e5e`): `Sources/TerminalNotificationStore.swift:636-670` has untyped text/read fields; `:972-979` replaces the latest notification for a tab. `Sources/AttentionModel.swift:375-429` keeps flags independently. `Sources/Events/EventEmitter.swift:138-165` has waiting edges and flags but no ask payload.
- `Sources/AppDelegate.swift:10829-10845` already resolves flag/notification jumps; reuse the target resolution rather than infer the focused tab.
- Upstream: cmux #3057, #15170; `Sources/Feed/FeedCoordinator.swift:251` and `Packages/macOS/CMUXAgentLaunch/Sources/CMUXAgentLaunch/Workstream/WorkstreamItem.swift` illustrate typed items and retirement. The blocking waiter machinery is explicitly not the proposed port.
- Research: report 03 “Data: an ask on each surface”; Fable §2 Feed F1; Astra §2 Feed F1 (flags coexist with asks; latest notification need not be latest unresolved ask). BACKLOG A2, D5/D6 and revised HTML Feed rows take precedence over report 03’s broader answer/classifier proposal.

## Scope
In: ask fields kind, prompt, options, source, opened_at, state; c11 feed list [--json], open <tab>, watch; ask.opened / ask.closed on the existing event stream. Represent question, plan, permission, turn_end and generic input distinctly; join explicit flags as a separate attention fact.
Out: automatic answering, feed answer (A6), quick view (A4), new producer adapters (J3/J4/J5), blocking request waiters, screen classification, menu-key answering, banners and durable request-consensus machinery.

## Approach
Use one projection from J2’s lifecycle fold plus bounded attention payloads on the notification/ask seam. Keep human-facing question text/options distinct from tool bodies; do not copy prompts/tool payloads into J2’s privacy-limited journal. Define which same-tab lifecycle events close an ask, and retain an unresolved ask when an unrelated telemetry notice arrives. A flag and an ask may coexist without either overwriting the other. Keep suppression semantics and source confidence visible. Feed open is explicit in-app focus intent; list/watch and event ingestion are not. For watch, start from a snapshot and refresh after detected restart/gap rather than claiming a durable event cursor. Do not duplicate J6’s lifecycle reason vocabulary.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Fixtures for question, plan, permission, generic input and turn completion produce typed JSON with target UUIDs, source, opened_at and state; unknown options/source remain explicit, without fabricated choices.
2. A flag plus a question on the same tab remains representable; a subsequent unrelated telemetry notification does not silently erase the unresolved question. Same-tab response/moved-on fixtures retire it; a sibling tool start does not.
3. Each tested open/close transition emits ask.opened/ask.closed with the correct target and documented bounded payload. Replaying a duplicate J2 event does not create a second open row.
4. feed list and watch agree after opening/closing asks, suppression changes and an app restart/reconnect; watch surfaces any unavailable continuity and refreshes. Suppressed routine asks stay out of the attention projection while flags remain visible.
5. feed open targets the selected row’s actual tab across workspaces. A closed tab returns an explicit unavailable result; no other tab receives input or is substituted. list/watch never move focus and no feed command in this ticket sends an answer.

## Validation
Use pure projection/lifecycle fixtures plus CLI/socket integration tests for list/open/watch and actual event emission. Drive a real tagged build with two workspaces and a flag-plus-ask tab; compare JSON, event output and visible target after open. Exercise mixed-agent updates in a bounded Atlas soak and compare main-thread/typing measurements with F2.

Builds and soaks run on Atlas once F1 / C11-216 lands, through the build lock. Use a tagged artifact and its socket, launched with C11_QA_LAUNCH=fresh (or the tagged automation launcher); never an untagged DEV app. Record exact artifact/head and distinguish fixture assertions from the real product pass. Update affected CLI/event skill contracts, run scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh for edited installable skills and verify the installed copy.

## Dependencies
Depends on A1 and J2. BACKLOG permits an earlier notification-record implementation, but this ticket’s chosen path uses J2; do not create a second independent store. Coordinate field names with J6 / C11-231 and bounded observation rules with J8. A3/A4/A6 consume this projection; cross-workstream links are for the lead.

## Risks
Ask text can contain private material. Keep journal analytics body-free, bound event payloads and document disclosure/retention for the ask surface. Preserve the C11-188 three-review-cycle limit and fixture-based correctness boundary. Keep telemetry parsing, I/O, deduplication and sorting off main; apply only the minimal UI mutation asynchronously. Preserve the hitTest pointer guard, TabItemView equality boundary and allocation-free forceRefresh path. No tenant config writes or trust broadening. Localize new product strings in English plus ja, uk, ko, zh-Hans, zh-Hant and ru; validate interpolation tokens. Sanitize fixtures, screenshots and logs before inclusion in this public repository.

Size: M. Tier: P1. Doctrine check: optional per-process observation and explicit operator actions only; no blocking bridge, automatic approval or persistent tenant configuration.
title: Feed: typed per-tab asks with list, open, watch and ask events
